evidence: empty_void: seg1:mid is ~70% empty gradient — a title, a hairline pink line hugging the bottom third and a thumbnail-sized mascot; seg4:start wastes the whole middle band between the two rows.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start, seg3:mid and seg3:end the right-hand bubble's label reads 'Classified as harmful invas' — truncated mid-word at x=430; the 3.5K bubble itself is a dim grey disc against a dark ground while the 37K disc is a flat pink circle with black text, so the comparison is two circles and a broken caption.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The label was laid out from a character count rather than a measured text extent and anchored to the small bubble's right side, so it overruns the frame; the depiction also falls back to a proportional-area bubble chart instead of a picture made of the subject.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Re-anchor and wrap both bubble labels so every glyph is inside a safe margin (measure the rendered extent, right-align the small bubble's caption inward), and replace the two-circle chart with a demonstration made of the subject — e.g. a field of 37,000 alien organisms of which a visibly small, differently-marked 3.5K cluster turns hostile — so the 1-in-10 ratio reads without the caption.
